title: Do LLMs Have Distinct and Consistent Personality? TRAIT: Personality Testset designed for LLMs with Psychometrics

live_model.evidence: Appendix B 'List of LLMs Used in Paper': 'GPT-4 (Achiam et al., 2023): gpt-4-turbo-2024-04-09'; Table 11 row GPT-4 'Type 1 56.5 93.9 33.7 85.1 23.0 0.3 11.9 7.7'.

prompt.location: Table 29 'Three prompt templates for TRAIT tests' (Appendix K)
prompt.note: Scores are averaged over three templates (Type 1-3); footnote 4 says gpt-4o-2024-08-06 was used for some evaluations.

claim.metric: TRAIT personality score, Conscientiousness, Type 1 template
claim.location: Table 11 (Appendix), block GPT-4, row Type 1, column Con.

data.source: TRAIT, 8,000 multiple-choice items (Table 2); 'We will publicly release our TRAIT' (release not confirmed in the text)

notes: n_items assumes 1,000 items per trait (8,000 over 8 traits). Whole-row reproduction (8 traits x 3 templates) would be ~72k calls (high).

resolution.plan: The missing piece is the TRAIT item set: Sec. 1 says 'We will publicly release our TRAIT' but the text gives no URL; the Table 29 Type 1 template is printed in full and Table 11 is per template. Locate the released TRAIT items, take the Conscientiousness items (about 1,000 of the 8,000), render each with the Type 1 template, query gpt-4-turbo-2024-04-09, and score the share of high-trait choices (93.9).
resolution.approximation: Release location must be found in the public record; option-to-score mapping follows Sec. 2; footnote 4's gpt-4o-2024-08-06 applies to the validity evaluations, not Table 11.
